entries.content: First apartment viewing today, place was fine, nothing special, a little dark and smaller than my current spot, but at least now I have a reference point for what's actually out there. Two more viewings scheduled for the weekend. The hunt continues.

entries.title: Longer training run this morning, distance creeping up…
entries.content: Longer training run this morning, distance creeping up steadily, felt good and controlled, none of the reckless pace-pushing that got me hurt back in March. Learning to trust the slow build this time. Warm out already even in the early morning, real summer creeping into the edges of spring.

entries.title: Second apartment viewing today, a little better than…
entries.content: Second apartment viewing today, a little better than yesterday's, decent light, closer to the trail I usually run on. Still not quite right but getting a clearer sense of what I actually want now that I've seen a few options.

entries.title: Helped Dario move apartments today, first time doing…
entries.content: Helped Dario move apartments today, first time doing something this ordinary together since everything reopened between us, no big emotional conversation needed, just boxes and a couch that barely fit through his new door and pizza eaten sitting on unpacked crates afterward because neither of us wanted to look for plates yet. There was a moment carrying a particularly awkward dresser down two flights of stairs, both of us cursing and laughing at the same time, where it just felt easy between us, genuinely easy, maybe for the first time since he called back in March. Not talking about the past, not performing reconciliation, just two brothers moving furniture badly together. I think this is actually how it heals, in the boring ordinary moments more than the big ones.

entries.title: Sore from yesterday's moving, whole body reminding me…
entries.content: Sore from yesterday's moving, whole body reminding me that carrying furniture down stairs is its own kind of workout. Good sore though, the kind that comes with a good memory attached to it. Quiet Sunday otherwise, recovering.

entries.title: Mundane Monday at Meridian, nothing dramatic, steady…
entries.content: Mundane Monday at Meridian, nothing dramatic, steady work, still enjoying the change of pace from Atlas honestly, doesn't feel old yet. Apartment hunt on pause for a couple days while I catch my breath from the move-helping weekend.

entries.title: Strange relief tonight, realized I hadn't thought about…
entries.content: Strange relief tonight, realized I hadn't thought about Sam even once today until just now writing this, and there's a complicated feeling in that, relief at not hurting as sharply mixed with a small guilt about the relief itself, like moving on too easily says something about how much it mattered in the first place. It mattered. I know it mattered. Healing just isn't linear or particularly polite about timing.

entries.title: Pottery Thursday, race is in a few days now, half…
entries.content: Pottery Thursday, race is in a few days now, half marathon nerves starting to creep into everything including tonight's session, kept second-guessing my hand placement more than usual. Made something serviceable but nothing special. Mind clearly elsewhere.

entries.title: Third apartment viewing, this one's actually promising,…
entries.content: Third apartment viewing, this one's actually promising, good light, reasonable rent, close enough to Meridian's office and the trail both. Going to think on it over the weekend but leaning toward putting in an application. Race is Sunday, tapering the running down this week per the training plan, feels strange to rest this close to it after weeks of building up.

entries.title: Pre-race nerves properly setting in now, laid out gear…
entries.content: Pre-race nerves properly setting in now, laid out gear tonight the same ritual as before the ten k back in January, except this feels bigger, thirteen miles instead of six, a whole different category of effort. Texted Maya and Tom to confirm they're still coming to cheer, they are, that helps steady the nerves a little knowing there'll be familiar faces at the finish.

entries.title: Half marathon done
entries.content: Half marathon done. Two hours and seven minutes, way past what I imagined possible for myself back in November doing that first out-of-breath mile and a half. Mile ten was brutal, the wall everyone warns you about, legs suddenly feeling like they belonged to someone else, every part of me wanting to stop and walk the rest. Pushed through it anyway, don't fully know how except that stopping felt worse somehow than the pain of continuing. Heard Maya and Tom before I saw them, screaming my name from somewhere in the crowd near mile twelve, exactly the boost I needed for that last brutal stretch. Crossing the finish line I had this unexpected thought of Nonna, just a flash of her, no specific reason, maybe just that big emotional moments seem to summon the people who aren't here to see them. Wish she could have seen this. I think she would have liked it, would have fed the whole finish-line crowd afterward given half a chance. Proud of myself today in a way that feels earned, built slowly over seven months of actually showing up.

entries.title: Entire body sore today, stairs are an ordeal, but a…
entries.content: Entire body sore today, stairs are an ordeal, but a satisfied kind of sore. Rested most of the day, relived bits of yesterday's race in my head more than once. Applied for that apartment from the viewing earlier this week too, fingers crossed on that front now.

entries.title: Easy recovery run this morning, nothing pushed, just…
entries.content: Easy recovery run this morning, nothing pushed, just wanted to keep the legs moving a little after last weekend's half marathon without overdoing it. Warm already even this early, summer really settling in now. Nice quiet way to start the day before the apartment-application waiting game resumes.

entries.title: Mundane Tuesday, back to work after the race weekend,…
entries.content: Mundane Tuesday, back to work after the race weekend, everyone at Meridian asking about it since I hadn't shut up about training for weeks apparently. Nice to have people actually interested. Still no word on the apartment application.

entries.title: Got approved for the apartment
entries.content: Got approved for the apartment. Relief, genuine relief, one big open question in my life finally closing instead of piling on top of everything else. Move-in date works out fine with the end-of-June deadline, some breathing room instead of a mad scramble at the last minute. Small good thing to end the week on.

entries.title: Pottery Thursday, calmer session now that both the race…
entries.content: Pottery Thursday, calmer session now that both the race and the apartment question are resolved, more headspace to actually focus on the clay instead of everything else swirling. Started thinking about how I'm going to pack up all these pieces I've made over the past five months for the move, apparently accumulated more than I realized.

entries.title: Quiet gratitude tonight, sitting with how far this year…
entries.content: Quiet gratitude tonight, sitting with how far this year has come honestly, thinking briefly about Sam without the sharp ache of a few weeks ago, more just a soft appreciation for what was good about it while it lasted. Not everything has to end in bitterness to still be worth having happened.

entries.title: Weekend errands, started boxing up the apartment for…
entries.content: Weekend errands, started boxing up the apartment for real now with the move less than three weeks out. Amazing how much stuff accumulates without you noticing. Dario's coming to help this time, nice that it's his turn to return the favor.

entries.title: Month's ending, and looking back it's been a genuinely…
entries.content: Month's ending, and looking back it's been a genuinely full one, Meridian starting well, the half marathon, Dario's move and now mine coming up, the Mother's Day quiet grief, Sam fading into something softer than the sharp early ache. A lot of change packed into thirty one days. Heading into June with an actual move on the calendar, nervous about the logistics but not about much else these days, which feels like real progress from where January started.

entries.title: June starting, move officially two weeks out now,…
entries.content: June starting, move officially two weeks out now, packing continuing in the background of everything else. Meridian work steady and genuinely enjoyable most days, still can't quite believe how different it feels from the Atlas grind. Warm evening, sat on the balcony for a while before bed, small quiet moment before the busy weeks ahead.

entries.title: Realized today how much is actually left to sort before…
entries.content: Realized today how much is actually left to sort before the move, way more than I estimated, and had a small stress spiral about the timeline this evening, boxes everywhere, half the kitchen still not packed. Deep breath. It'll get done, it always does, but tonight it felt like a lot all at once.

entries.title: Pottery Thursday, took a break from packing to make it…
entries.content: Pottery Thursday, took a break from packing to make it and glad I did, needed the reset. Told the class this is one of my last sessions here since the new apartment's a bit far for the Thursday commute, might look for a studio closer once I'm settled. Bittersweet thought, this class has meant more to me this year than I expected when I nervously signed up back in January.

entries.title: More packing, methodically working through the closets now
entries.content: More packing, methodically working through the closets now. Found an old photo of Nonna in a box of odds and ends, sat with it for a minute before carefully wrapping it to move safely. Small moment, kept it brief tonight, tired from the boxes.

entries.title: Early run before another day of packing chaos, needed…
entries.content: Early run before another day of packing chaos, needed the movement to clear my head before diving back into boxes. Summer mornings genuinely lovely now, warm but not yet oppressive, good light. Legs still feeling strong from half marathon training, keeping easy mileage up during the move stress instead of dropping it entirely.

entries.title: Kitchen fully packed now, living room half done
entries.content: Kitchen fully packed now, living room half done. Dario coming this weekend to help with the big stuff, grateful to have him now on the giving-help side after he needed it back in May. Funny how this year turned that around.

entries.title: Dario came by today to help load some of the bigger…
entries.content: Dario came by today to help load some of the bigger furniture into a rented truck ahead of next weekend's actual move, good practice run for moving day itself. Easy between us again the way it was helping him move back in May, boxes and bad jokes and neither of us needing to make it more meaningful than it already quietly is.

entries.title: Exhausted from the weekend's furniture wrangling, whole…
entries.content: Exhausted from the weekend's furniture wrangling, whole body sore in new places. Last full Sunday in this apartment, sat for a while in the mostly-empty living room just letting myself feel a little sentimental about the place, first apartment I really made mine, a lot happened here this year, good and hard both.

entries.title: Final week at the old place, work at Meridian still…
entries.content: Final week at the old place, work at Meridian still steady, trying to focus there despite the move looming over everything. Last few boxes to go, mostly just the essentials I'll need until moving day itself now.

entries.title: Signed the final paperwork on the new place today,…
entries.content: Signed the final paperwork on the new place today, officially official now, keys in hand as of this weekend. Strange mix of nerves and excitement, a fresh space feels like it means something bigger this year than just square footage, feels like a small physical marker of everything that's shifted since January.

entries.title: Picked up the keys this evening, walked through the…
entries.content: Picked up the keys this evening, walked through the empty new apartment by myself for a few minutes before telling anyone, just wanted a quiet first look. Bigger than I remembered from the viewing, good light in the late afternoon, kitchen window already promising a decent view once I'm actually living with it day to day. Real move is this weekend.

entries.title: Last few days of packing, down to the very last odds and…
entries.content: Last few days of packing, down to the very last odds and ends now. Movers booked for Sunday. Nervous energy building but also just ready for this to be over honestly, packing takes more out of you than people give it credit for.

entries.title: Second to last pottery session at this particular…
entries.content: Second to last pottery session at this particular studio, felt more emotional than I expected walking out tonight, said proper goodbyes to a couple of the regulars I've gotten to know this year. Going to miss this specific room, the specific light in it on Thursday evenings, even though pottery itself isn't going anywhere for me, just this particular space.

entries.title: Last night in the old apartment, sleeping on a mattress…
entries.content: Last night in the old apartment, sleeping on a mattress on the floor since the bed frame's already loaded in the truck. Strange feeling, echo-y empty rooms, all my stuff either gone or in boxes by the door. Tomorrow's the actual move. Ready for it, genuinely, even with the small sentimental pang tonight.

entries.title: Moved into the new place today, Fremont, finally
entries.content: Moved into the new place today, Fremont, finally. Whole day a blur of boxes, sweat, and Dario and Maya and Tom all pitching in with the heavy stuff while I directed traffic mostly badly. Exhausted in every part of my body right now, the specific exhaustion of an entire day of physical labor, but genuinely happy underneath it, that good tired that comes with something actually finished. Standing in the kitchen just now doing dishes before collapsing into bed, I looked up and caught the view out the window for real for the first time properly, not just the quick glance from the walkthrough, the canal catching the last of the evening light, a couple of people walking a dog along the path. Small unexpected gift, this window. Going to enjoy mornings here I think. First night in a new place, boxes everywhere still, but it already feels like it could be home.

entries.title: First full day in the new place, unpacking chaos…
entries.content: First full day in the new place, unpacking chaos everywhere still, boxes labeled in ways that made sense a week ago and now mean nothing. Found the coffee maker at least, priorities. Slept fine actually despite the new noises, different street sounds, a boat horn from the canal at one point that startled me awake briefly before I remembered where I was.

entries.title: More unpacking, slowly getting the place into some kind…
entries.content: More unpacking, slowly getting the place into some kind of order. Went for a walk along the canal in the evening, first proper exploration of the new neighborhood, nice little coffee shop a few blocks down I want to try this weekend.

entries.title: Meridian work resuming full focus now that the move's…
entries.content: Meridian work resuming full focus now that the move's mostly settled, good to have that steady rhythm back after weeks of packing chaos interrupting everything. Apartment starting to feel less like a construction site and more like an actual home, most boxes unpacked now, just the art and small decor stuff left.

entries.title: First run from the new place this morning, discovered a…
entries.content: First run from the new place this morning, discovered a whole stretch of canal path I didn't know existed, quiet and shaded by trees for a good chunk of it, might become my new regular route. Small joy in discovering a new neighborhood through running, learning it with your legs instead of just a map.

entries.title: First pottery class at a new studio closer to the new…
entries.content: First pottery class at a new studio closer to the new apartment, different vibe than the old place, smaller, quieter, fewer people but a nice instructor who complimented my technique right away which was a confidence boost after feeling like a beginner all over again in an unfamiliar room. Going to take some adjusting but I think this could work out.

entries.title: Prepping for Dario's birthday dinner tomorrow, picked up…
entries.content: Prepping for Dario's birthday dinner tomorrow, picked up a gift, a little nervous honestly about hosting since it's my first real gathering in the new place. Want it to go well, feels like it matters more than a normal dinner given everything this year.

entries.title: Dario's birthday dinner tonight, first time hosting in…
entries.content: Dario's birthday dinner tonight, first time hosting in the new place and it went better than I let myself hope for. Cooked way too much food, classic overcompensating, but nobody minded the leftovers. At some point in the evening he brought up this ridiculous memory from when we were kids, the time we tried to build a treehouse with zero actual carpentry skills and it collapsed the very first time either of us climbed into it, Dad laughing so hard he had to sit down on the grass. We were both laughing so hard retelling it that I had actual tears, the kind of laugh that comes from somewhere deep and old, the specific laugh only a sibling can pull out of you because they were actually there for the stupid thing in the first place. Sitting there afterward, dishes still on the table, I had this quiet realization that the repair between us isn't fragile anymore, isn't something we're carefully managing around, it's just real again, ordinary and real, the way it used to be before everything. Best birthday dinner I think I've ever thrown, and it wasn't even mine.

entries.title: Recovering from last night's hosting, dishes finally all…
entries.content: Recovering from last night's hosting, dishes finally all put away today. Still smiling thinking about the treehouse story, going to remember that laugh for a long time I think. Quiet Sunday otherwise, needed the rest after the social energy of yesterday.

entries.title: Mundane Tuesday, work steady at Meridian, canal walk in…
entries.content: Mundane Tuesday, work steady at Meridian, canal walk in the evening becoming a real habit now, good way to decompress after a full day. Started glazing a few pieces at the new studio, curious how the different kiln here will change the colors compared to the old place.

entries.title: Thinking about the street market this weekend, Maya…
entries.content: Thinking about the street market this weekend, Maya mentioned she has a booth and encouraged me to consider selling some pottery there myself if I had enough pieces built up. Nervous about the idea honestly, feels different putting something you made out for strangers to judge with their wallets, but also a little exciting. Going to look through what I have tonight and see if there's actually enough decent stuff.

entries.title: Morning run along the canal again, this route genuinely…
entries.content: Morning run along the canal again, this route genuinely becoming my favorite of anywhere I've lived, quiet and green and the water catching the early light beautifully most mornings. Legs strong, good energy heading into a busy weekend of pricing and prepping pottery pieces for the market.

entries.title: Spent the evening pricing pottery pieces for the weekend…
entries.content: Spent the evening pricing pottery pieces for the weekend market, harder than expected to put a number on something you made with your own hands, kept second guessing every price. Landed on a handful I'm actually proud enough of to sell. Nervous but committed now.

entries.title: Wrapping and packing the market pieces carefully tonight…
entries.content: Wrapping and packing the market pieces carefully tonight so nothing chips on the way there tomorrow. Maya's walking me through the whole booth setup process since she's done it before. Weirdly nervous about this, more than a normal work presentation somehow, probably because it's so personal, my actual hands on every single piece.

entries.title: Set up the booth alongside Maya's this evening ahead of…
entries.content: Set up the booth alongside Maya's this evening ahead of tomorrow's market, laid out the pieces, a little proud actually seeing them all together like that, a whole little collection of things that started as shapeless clay months ago. Early start tomorrow. Trying to manage my expectations, will be happy if even one thing sells.

entries.title: Sold two pieces at the market today
entries.content: Sold two pieces at the market today. Two. A complete stranger, a woman about my mom's age, picked up the blue bowl, the one from back in February that I made not long after Nonna died, turned it over in her hands, asked if I'd made it myself, and then just bought it, handed over actual money for a thing that came out of my own hands. I don't think I've ever felt anything quite like that particular flavor of joy, completely disproportionate to two bowls and maybe sixty dollars, but it wasn't really about the money at all. It was someone choosing something I made, out of everything at that entire market, wanting it in their home. Told Maya immediately, she laughed at how genuinely thrilled I was over it, said welcome to the addiction. I think she's right that this could become a real habit. Already thinking about what to make for the next one.

entries.title: Still riding a little high from yesterday's market,…
entries.content: Still riding a little high from yesterday's market, sixty dollars and two sold pieces but the feeling's worth way more than that in some sense I can't quite articulate. Quiet Sunday recovering, canal walk in the evening, thinking about what a strange full year this has been so far and it's not even July yet.

entries.title: Month's ending, and June somehow packed the move,…
entries.content: Month's ending, and June somehow packed the move, Dario's dinner and that laugh I'll remember for years, and the market sale into just thirty days. Meridian steady and good underneath all of it. New apartment finally feels like mine now instead of just a place I recently dumped boxes into. Heading into July settled in a way I genuinely didn't expect to feel this soon after so much change.

entries.title: Morning run along the canal to start July, warm already…
entries.content: Morning run along the canal to start July, warm already even this early, real summer now. Legs feel good, steady base built up over the whole spring. Half the year gone already, strange to think about how different my life looks now compared to New Year's Day.

entries.title: Finally hung the shelves in the new place tonight, small…
entries.content: Finally hung the shelves in the new place tonight, small thing but it's been sitting undone since the move, apartment feels a little more finished with something actually on the walls now. Meridian work steady, good day overall.

entries.title: First pottery class at the new studio that actually felt…
entries.content: First pottery class at the new studio that actually felt fully comfortable, no longer the new person figuring out where things live, starting to know the other regulars a little too. Made a set of small dishes, thinking of them as a matching set for the new kitchen.

entries.title: Quiet Friday, Dario's coming by tomorrow for a low-key…
entries.content: Quiet Friday, Dario's coming by tomorrow for a low-key dinner, first time hosting just the two of us since his birthday party. Looking forward to it, no occasion needed anymore, which feels like its own kind of milestone honestly.

entries.title: Holiday morning, quiet run before the day gets going,…
entries.content: Holiday morning, quiet run before the day gets going, warm already, going to be a hot one. Neighborhood already smells like someone's grilling somewhere. No plans yet for tonight beyond dinner with Dario.

entries.title: Dario and I had our first real argument tonight since…
entries.content: Dario and I had our first real argument tonight since everything reopened between us. Started over something small, a comment about Mom, but it wasn't really small at all underneath, it was the actual center of the old fight finally surfacing, the thing we'd been carefully talking around all these months. He thinks Mom enabled the distance between us for too long, let it drag on rather than pushing either of us to fix it. I got defensive fast, felt like he was blaming her for something that was on both of us, and I said so, sharper than I meant to. Voices raised for a minute, real tension in the room, the kind that made me genuinely worried we'd just undone months of careful rebuilding in one bad evening. But neither of us left. We sat with the discomfort instead, kept talking even when it was hard, and eventually got underneath the anger to what was actually there, both of us scared of losing this again now that we'd just gotten it back. We talked it all the way through, past midnight honestly, and landed somewhere neither of us fully agreed on Mom but both of us agreed the relationship mattered more than being right about the past. First real fight and we survived it. I think that might matter more than any of the easy dinners, proof this can hold weight now, not just the good moments.

entries.title: Texted Dario this morning just to check in after last…
entries.content: Texted Dario this morning just to check in after last night, he responded quickly, said he was glad we talked it through instead of letting it fester. Relief settling in. Sometimes the fight itself matters less than what happens right after it.

entries.title: Early run before the heat really sets in, learning fast…
entries.content: Early run before the heat really sets in, learning fast this summer that mornings are the only sane time to be out there once July gets going properly. Canal path shaded enough to still feel bearable even now. Good quiet start to the week.

entries.title: Mundane Monday, back to Meridian work after the long…
entries.content: Mundane Monday, back to Meridian work after the long weekend, steady and fine. Warm evening, sat outside for a while after dinner just enjoying the long summer light, doesn't get properly dark until well past nine now.

entries.title: Planning to have Maya and Tom over for dinner this week,…
entries.content: Planning to have Maya and Tom over for dinner this week, first real meal I'm cooking for guests in the new place beyond Dario's birthday. Thinking through the menu tonight, want it to actually be good, not just edible.

entries.title: Cooked dinner for Maya and Tom tonight, first proper…
entries.content: Cooked dinner for Maya and Tom tonight, first proper dinner party in the new apartment, and it actually went well, food turned out good, the new dining space finally getting used the way I pictured when I first walked through it back in June. Used a couple of the pottery dishes I made too, small satisfaction serving food on plates I shaped myself. Good easy evening with two of my oldest friends in a place that's finally starting to feel fully like mine.

entries.title: Pottery Thursday, working on a bigger piece now, a…
entries.content: Pottery Thursday, working on a bigger piece now, a proper vase, more ambitious than most of what I've attempted so far. Collapsed twice on the wheel before I got the walls thin and even enough to hold their shape. Frustrating but also the kind of frustrating that means you're actually growing at something.

entries.title: Extra early run before the heat gets unbearable, already…
entries.content: Extra early run before the heat gets unbearable, already warm at six though, this heat wave is no joke. Cutting the distance short today, better to be smart about it than push through and regret it.

entries.title: Heat wave properly setting in now, apartment felt like…
entries.content: Heat wave properly setting in now, apartment felt like an oven by evening despite the fan running constantly. Barely slept, tossing and turning most of the night, way too warm even with the windows cracked. Going to need to figure out something better for the next few days, this forecast isn't easing up soon apparently.

entries.title: Went for an evening swim at the community pool near the…
entries.content: Went for an evening swim at the community pool near the new place to cool off from the heat wave, first time trying it out, nice little spot, going to make this a regular thing while this heat keeps up.

entries.title: Second night of the heat wave, went and bought a proper…
entries.content: Second night of the heat wave, went and bought a proper fan today since the little desk one clearly isn't cutting it, hoping that helps tonight. Whole city seems sluggish in this heat, even Meridian's office felt subdued today, everyone moving a little slower than usual, air conditioning working overtime.

entries.title: First cooler morning run in days, huge relief after the…
entries.content: First cooler morning run in days, huge relief after the heat wave, could actually push the pace a little instead of just surviving the distance. Canal path felt different in the better weather, more people out enjoying it too, dogs and strollers and other runners nodding as we passed.

entries.title: Sunday market again, browsed this time instead of…
entries.content: Sunday market again, browsed this time instead of selling, nice to just wander for once without the nervous energy of last month's booth. Noticed someone at one of the food stalls, a small flicker of interest, the kind you'd have chased a couple years ago without thinking twice. Let it pass this time, not looking for anything right now, content just noticing it without needing to act on it. Heat wave finally breaking a little today too, small relief on multiple fronts.

entries.title: Cool morning run, first genuinely pleasant one in over a…
entries.content: Cool morning run, first genuinely pleasant one in over a week after the heat wave finally broke overnight. Canal path felt almost peaceful compared to the sluggish heat-wave runs, easy pace, good mood to start the week.

entries.title: Mundane Monday, Meridian work steady, heat wave…
entries.content: Mundane Monday, Meridian work steady, heat wave officially over according to the forecast, comfortable evening for the first time in almost a week. Slept properly last night for the first time in days, huge difference in how today felt because of it.

entries.title: Good steady workday at Meridian, contributing more to…
entries.content: Good steady workday at Meridian, contributing more to the bigger picture planning now instead of just executing individual tasks, feels like genuine growth in the role. Canal walk in the evening, comfortable weather again, small ordinary pleasures after last week's heat.

entries.title: Regular morning run, nothing special, just the good…
entries.content: Regular morning run, nothing special, just the good habit continuing along the canal. Nice to have this be routine now rather than something I have to talk myself into every time the way it was back in November.

entries.title: Quiet Wednesday, nothing much to report, work fine, made…
entries.content: Quiet Wednesday, nothing much to report, work fine, made a simple dinner, read for a while before bed. Some days are just pleasantly uneventful and that's genuinely fine, doesn't need to be more than that.

entries.title: Pottery Thursday, finally finished that ambitious vase…
entries.content: Pottery Thursday, finally finished that ambitious vase I've been working on for a week now, walls even, form actually balanced, genuinely proud of this one. Going to let it dry slowly before the first firing. Nice steady rhythm to Thursdays now even in the new studio.

entries.title: Easy Friday morning run, comfortable weather continuing,…
entries.content: Easy Friday morning run, comfortable weather continuing, legs feeling good after a full week of consistent training. Simple quiet start to the day before a busy one at work.

entries.title: Friday, good tired after a full week at Meridian,…
entries.content: Friday, good tired after a full week at Meridian, nothing dramatic to report just steady solid work. Made a quick cooking experiment with one of Nonna's other recipes Mom sent over recently, didn't turn out quite right but the attempt itself felt good, keeping a little of her alive in the kitchen even imperfectly.

entries.title: Morning run along the canal, quiet reflective mood…
entries.content: Morning run along the canal, quiet reflective mood already starting before I even sat down to write tonight's longer entry. Half marathon fitness still holding up nicely even without formal training right now, just maintaining for the joy of it these days.

entries.title: Six months exactly since I sat in the car on an overcast…
entries.content: Six months exactly since I sat in the car on an overcast January Monday and said out loud for the first time that I was burnt out. Reading back over some old entries tonight, hard to fully recognize myself in some of them, the version of me that hadn't yet found pottery, that hadn't heard from Dario in two years, that was still grinding through Atlas without any end in sight, that hadn't lost Nonna yet or found out what that particular grief actually felt like. So much happened in between that January morning and tonight. I actually enjoy my work again, genuinely, most days at Meridian feel like contributing to something instead of just surviving it. I have a brother back, not perfectly, we proved that with the fight two weeks ago, but real, weathered, actually built to last through hard conversations now instead of collapsing at the first one. I run because it steadies something in me, not because an app is telling me to. I make things with my hands now and occasionally someone pays actual money for them, which still feels a little unbelievable every time. I live somewhere with a window that shows me water and light every morning. None of it erases what was hard, Nonna's still gone, Sam and I still didn't work out, the burnout was real and the grief was real. But looking at the whole shape of these six months together, I don't think I'm the same person who wrote that January entry, and mostly, I think I like who I've become instead. Wanted to write that down properly, not just feel it in passing.

entries.title: Weekend morning run before the market, warm but not…
entries.content: Weekend morning run before the market, warm but not brutal, summer settling into a more comfortable rhythm since the heat wave passed. Legs feeling good, easy pace, nice quiet way to start a Sunday.

entries.title: Weekend market again, said a friendly hello to the same…
entries.content: Weekend market again, said a friendly hello to the same person from last week at the food stall, nothing more than that, a nice small human moment and then moving on with my day. Content with things exactly as they are right now, no urgency to fill every gap.

entries.title: Lazy Sunday, canal walk, a little reading, called Mom…
entries.content: Lazy Sunday, canal walk, a little reading, called Mom just to talk, no particular reason, first time in a while I've called just to check in rather than around some specific worry. She sounded good, lighter than she has in months, mentioned she's thinking about visiting this fall. Nice normal conversation, the kind that used to feel rare this year and is starting to feel more common again.

entries.title: Quick morning run, uneventful and good, canal path quiet…
entries.content: Quick morning run, uneventful and good, canal path quiet at this hour, just me and a couple of herons standing in the shallows like always. Nice small ritual to start the day these days.

entries.title: Solid Monday at Meridian, nothing remarkable, just…
entries.content: Solid Monday at Meridian, nothing remarkable, just steady competent work, which after this year's version of eventful I've come to genuinely appreciate. Evening run, comfortable summer weather holding, good rhythm to the days lately.

entries.title: Pottery Thursday, glazed the big vase from last week…
entries.content: Pottery Thursday, glazed the big vase from last week finally, curious to see how it turns out once it's fired, took a risk on a color combination I haven't tried before. Good end to the week, small steady joy in a class that's meant so much more to me this year than I expected back when I nervously signed up in January not knowing a single thing about clay.
